contexts: patients living up to 150 km away
reading: Dose reduction, pain interference and safety all run through the same mechanism: frequent contact during slow steps. The retrieved evidence links pharmacist contact to more dose reduction and fewer patients leaving care, and links fast reductions without follow-up to emergency visits. Disengagement is the weak point, and it is patterned by distance and language, so the patients the clinic loses are the ones whose outcomes matter most for safety.
